name: Academic Committee
description: Focused on enhancing academic performance through tutoring sessions, study groups, and educational resources for medical sciences students.

name: Media Committee
description: Creating compelling visual content, managing social media presence, and documenting NEURO events and achievements.

name: AI Committee
description: Developing and maintaining AI-powered tools and chatbots to assist students with their medical sciences studies.

name: Research Committee
description: Promoting scientific research culture among students and supporting research projects in applied medical sciences.

name: Events Committee
description: Planning and executing workshops, seminars, competitions, and social events that bring the student community together.

name: Volunteer Committee
description: Coordinating volunteer activities and community service projects that make a positive impact on campus and beyond.

name: Public Relations
description: Building and maintaining relationships with university administration, other student organizations, and external partners.
